七.description: A short horizontal stroke crosses a longer bent stroke to form one compact character. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

十.description: One horizontal and one vertical stroke cross at the center. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

五.description: Outer strokes frame shorter strokes inside the character. The note describes the visible form and does not assign meanings to the individual strokes.

习.description: A hooked upper stroke turns around toward the right above two lower strokes. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

电.description: A box-like center joins a descending hooked stroke into one compact form. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

车.description: Horizontal strokes cross a central vertical stroke, with a lower crossbar completing the compact form. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

友.description: The upper-left strokes sit above and along the left side of the lower 又-shaped strokes. This describes placement only, not historical origin.

气.description: Short slanting strokes sit above a longer horizontal stroke that turns at the right. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

面.description: A broad top stroke sits over a framed center with shorter strokes inside. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

觉.description: Small strokes sit at the top, a short roof-like bar is below them, and the lower 見 form completes the character. This describes placement, not historical origin.

雨.description: A broad top cover sits over a central vertical stroke and pairs of short interior strokes. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

本.description: A horizontal stroke crosses the lower part of the 木-shaped form. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

东.description: A top horizontal stroke crosses the central form, with short lower strokes extending beneath it. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

飞.description: Three strokes curve and cross within a compact form. The note describes the visible strokes only, not their historical origin.

兴.description: Small upper strokes sit above a central horizontal stroke and two lower strokes. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.

高.description: A top cover sits above a central opening and a wider lower framed form. This describes the visible layout, not the character's historical origin.
